skill.name: youtube-content-research
skill.description: Search YouTube through SocialDataX and organize video samples for topic research, channel observation, and competitor comparisons.
skill.summary: Find YouTube video samples and turn them into research notes with source links.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: The documented CLI fetches and runs an unpinned npm package that can access a SocialDataX credential. Most static flags match Markdown syntax or documentation, and no evidence of embedded secrets, obfuscation, or prompt injection was found. The workflow can send search terms to SocialDataX and consume credits without a separate preflight confirmation.

remediation.issue: Authentication and search rely on a mutable npm release.
remediation.suggestion: Pin and review the CLI and its dependencies. Verify package integrity and require explicit approval before installing or updating it.

remediation.issue: The CLI can read environment credentials or a persistent credential file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a dedicated, least-privilege credential. Run the reviewed CLI in an isolated environment without unrelated secrets or home directory access.

remediation.issue: Search terms and source labels leave the environment, and requests may consume credits.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the destination and possible charges before search. Ask the user to approve the terms and a page or request limit.

content.value_statement: YouTube search results can be difficult to compare across topics or channels. Use SocialDataX to gather focused video samples and organize them into an evidence-based brief.
actual_capabilities: Search YouTube videos by keyword through the SocialDataX CLI or its corresponding MCP tool.
Use the CLI to filter by publication time, duration, or video type and sort by views, date, or rating.
Limit CLI searches by page or item count and resume the same query with its continuation token.
Collect titles, creators, links or video IDs, and available dates or metrics for review.
Summarize patterns in the sampled videos and distinguish observations from interpretations.
limitations: Live search requires a configured SocialDataX credential or an authenticated MCP connection. Search requests may use credits.
The workflow searches by keyword. A channel name can narrow results, but it does not guarantee a complete upload history.
Search has no exhaustive mode. Missing results or metrics cannot support a conclusion about all of YouTube.
The skill does not retrieve transcripts, download videos, or make changes to a YouTube account.

use_cases.title: Find Topics for a New Video
use_cases.description: Review a small set of videos on a subject. Identify recurring formats and questions to explore next.

use_cases.title: Compare Competitor Coverage
use_cases.description: Search for two brands with the same topic and date filters. Compare how each presents the topic in the returned sample.

use_cases.title: Review Recent Publishing Patterns
use_cases.description: Collect recent videos on a category and group them by format. Keep source links so the editorial team can review the evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Video Sample
prompt_templates.prompt: Search YouTube for beginner watercolor exercises. Fetch one page and list each relevant title, creator, and link or video ID.

prompt_templates.title: Filter Recent Short Videos
prompt_templates.prompt: Find YouTube videos about balcony herb gardens from this month. Keep videos under four minutes, sort by views, and stop at ten results.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Two Brands
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for Brand A and Brand B separately using the phrase compact espresso machine. Use the same date filter and ten-result limit for each. Compare the topics and formats, and cite the samples.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Bounded Research Brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Research videos about heat pump maintenance from this year. Stop after three pages or twenty results, whichever comes first. Mark any partial results. Separate observations from hypotheses and include links and follow-up questions.

output_examples.input: Find one page of videos about beginner watercolor exercises.
output: Illustrative sample: A color mixing tutorial and a guided brush control exercise.
Observation: Both titles name a specific practice activity.
Follow-up: Compare these formats with longer painting demonstrations.

output_examples.input: Compare short balcony herb garden videos published this month.
output: Illustrative comparison: Two samples focus on planting, and a third covers watering.
Interpretation: Setup advice is more common than maintenance advice in this sample.
Limit: The sample does not establish a broader YouTube trend.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a result or page limit before expanding.
Use the same search filters and limits when comparing topics, brands, or channels.
Keep source links or video IDs and separate observed evidence from your interpretation.
anti_patterns: Do not paste a real API key into a prompt or command argument.
Do not treat an empty page or a partial response as proof that no more results exist.
Do not present a small keyword sample as a complete channel inventory or platform-wide trend.

faq.question: Do I need a YouTube account?
faq.answer: No YouTube account login is required by the documented workflow. Search uses a SocialDataX credential or an authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection.

faq.question: Can I use an existing MCP connection?
faq.answer: Yes. An authenticated SocialDataX MCP connection with the YouTube search tool does not require separate local CLI credentials.

faq.question: How do I keep my key out of chat?
faq.answer: Configure it in your local credential setup or approved secret manager. Do not paste it into a prompt, command argument, or project file.

faq.question: Can a search return every matching video?
faq.answer: No. Search uses bounded pagination and does not offer an exhaustive mode.

faq.question: What happens when credits run out?
faq.answer: Stop retrying and review the balance in your SocialDataX account. Once resolved, use any valid continuation token and keep the original limits.

faq.question: Can the skill post or comment on YouTube?
faq.answer: No. The documented YouTube workflow is read-only and does not post, like, comment, or change an account.
